rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that stays unchanged or permanent.

example.english: This color has remained constant for years.
example.traditional: 呢個顏色多年嚟都不變。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ngaan4 sik1 do1 nin4 lei4 dou1 bat1 bin3

rows.note: Use this when an event, condition, or problem keeps happening or continues over time.

example.english: This problem has been constant for several weeks.
example.traditional: 呢個問題持續咗幾個星期。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ci4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4

rows.note: Use this for someone who remains firm and steadfast in feelings, purpose, or action.

example.english: Their belief in their ideals has remained constant.
example.traditional: 佢對理想嘅信念一直都好堅定。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 lei5 soeng2 ge3 seon3 nim6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gin1 ding6
